Biang Xingchen (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2026, headquartered in Beijing. It was established in 2017 and is a technology company focused on the design, manufacturing, and operation of electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft (eVTOL). Its first product is the longest-endurance (580 km range) all-electric aircraft in its class of drones, with the longest flight time in that class. The company has R&D, smart manufacturing, and operations centers in Sichuan, Guizhou, and Inner Mongolia.

The company is among the first in China to adopt additive manufacturing for its airframes, automating the production of the entire aircraft structure and fundamentally changing how aircraft are built. This "smart manufacturing" approach has substantially reduced manufacturing costs and greatly improved production efficiency.

必昂星辰（深圳）科技有限公司成立于2026年，总部位于北京，成立于2017年，是一家专注于垂直起降电动飞机（eVTOL）设计、制造与运营的科技型企业。首型产品为同级别无人机中航时最长、航程最远（580公里）的纯电动飞机。公司在四川、贵州、内蒙古设有研发、智造与运营中心。

公司率先在国内采用增材制造工艺，实现整机结构的自动化生产，彻底革新了传统飞行器制造方式。这一“智造”模式使整机制造成本大幅降低，生产效率大幅提升。
